mcp_tools.name: crypto_inventory_pq_migration_map
mcp_tools.title: Crypto inventory pq migration map
mcp_tools.description: Submit a crypto inventory (algorithm, purpose, shelf-life per use); get a deterministic post-quantum migration map — each use classified (quantum-vulnerable, hybrid, PQ-ready, symmetric/hash not broken, unknown), mapped to its NIST PQ target family (ML-KEM / ML-DSA / SLH-DSA, hybrid first), and ordered in migration priority by shelf-life.

inputSchema.description: The crypto inventory manifest (see the atom's SERVICE.md for the field table and entry schema).

system.description: System / estate whose cryptography is inventoried.

inventory.description: Crypto inventory entries: {id, surface, algorithm, purpose, shelf_life_years, owner}.
